cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-1
cards.referenceText: This is a sample answer that should be adapted to the speaker’s real experience. I am a student pilot. I take flight training at my flight school. I fly the DA-40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only have my private pilot license.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是一个应根据答题者真实经历调整的示范回答。我是一名飞行学员，在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 进行飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，目前仅持有私人飞行员执照。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-2
cards.audioText: What type of aircraft are you flying now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前驾驶的是哪种机型？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot. I take flight training at my flight school. I fly the DA-40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only hold my private pilot license.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是一名飞行学员，在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 开展飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，目前仅持有私人飞行员执照。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-3
cards.audioText: When did you take the transition training?
cards.referenceText: I have not taken the transition training yet. Now I take flight training at my flight school. I fly the DA-40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only hold my private pilot license.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我尚未进行转机型训练。目前我在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 开展飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，现在仅持有私人飞行员执照。
